name: io.github.cyanheads/earthquake-mcp-server
description: Search USGS and EMSC seismic data — real-time feeds, event queries, and earthquake counts.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: USGS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: USGS API base URL. Override for testing or mirroring.

environmentVariables.name: EMSC_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: EMSC API base URL. Override for testing or mirroring.

environmentVariables.name: DEFAULT_LIMIT
environmentVariables.description: Events earthquake_search_events returns when a call omits limit (1-1000).

environmentVariables.name: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per-attempt HTTP timeout in milliseconds (1000-120000). Feed, search, and event calls also share a 50-second total deadline across every request and retry; standalone count calls use this per-attempt value.

environmentVariables.name: EARTHQUAKE_CLAMP_LIMITS
environmentVariables.description: Clamp a search or feed limit above 1000 to 1000 with a notice. Set false to advertise and enforce a maximum of 1000 instead.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
